meta.title: Word Daily for Kindle & E-Ink — Free Daily Word Game
meta.description: Play a free daily word game in your Kindle, BOOX or Kobo browser. One new five-letter puzzle every day — no download, no install, made for e-ink screens.

h1: Word Daily for Kindle & E-Ink — Free, No Download
tagline: A Wordle-style daily word game that runs right in the browser of your Kindle, BOOX or Kobo — one five-letter word a day, the same word for every player, drawn in pure black and white.

steps: Guess today's five-letter word. Every player gets the same word each day — the puzzle is tied to the date, not to your device, so you can compare results with friends. You have six tries, and a new word arrives tomorrow.

Type your first guess. Tap the on-screen QWERTY keyboard with a finger or stylus, or type on a physical keyboard if your e-reader has one or a keyboard is paired — hardware keys, Enter and Backspace all work alongside the touch keyboard.

Read the feedback. After each guess the tiles answer in pure black and white: a solid black tile means the letter sits in the right spot, a bold outlined tile means the letter is in the word but somewhere else, and a thin outlined tile means it is not in the word at all.

Watch the keyboard history. Every on-screen key carries the same three marks for letters you have already tried, so at a glance you know which letters are placed, which survive elsewhere, and which are dead ends.
Mind repeated letters. The hidden word may contain the same letter twice; the feedback counts each copy carefully, so a bold outline never promises more copies than the word actually holds.

Play unlimited practice rounds. Done with the daily word and hungry for more? Switch to Practice mode for a fresh random word at any time — practice rounds never touch your daily result, win streak or statistics.

Share and come back. When the puzzle ends, a plain-text result grid appears — long-press to select and copy it anywhere you like. Your daily progress, streak and statistics are saved on your device automatically.

whyEInk: Word puzzles are text, and e-ink renders text beautifully. This game redraws only the tiles that change — no animations, no flashing, no gray halos — so the board reads like a printed page in any light. The once-a-day format fits e-readers perfectly: one word, a quiet minute of thought, and a screen that never glows back.

faq.a: Yes. The daily word and unlimited practice rounds are completely free, with no account, no ads and no paywall. The site belongs to the E-Ink.me family of free e-reader tools, so there is nothing to buy and nothing to sign up for — just open the page and play.

faq.q: Does it work on my Kindle Paperwhite?
faq.a: On Paperwhite, Scribe and Colorsoft models from 2021 onward with firmware 5.13.7 or newer, yes — the built-in browser runs the whole game. Older Kindles with the early experimental browser can read this page as plain text, but the puzzle itself will not start on them.

faq.q: Do I need to jailbreak my Kindle?
faq.a: No. The game runs entirely inside the browser your Kindle already ships with. There is no app to install, no file to sideload and no modification of any kind — if your device can open an ordinary web page, it can play Word Daily.

You need a connection the first time the page loads, because the site is delivered as a normal web page rather than a downloadable app. Once it has loaded, every guess runs on the device itself and your streak is stored locally — but plan to be online when you start.
